data.name: Naba
data.gender_notes: Naba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-y' which means to call, announce or make an announcement. In Islamic context, Naba is associated with the Angel Gabriel who conveyed the divine revelations to Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Naba carries the meaning “Awakening, Announcement” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naba usually hope their child will grow to embody awakening, announcement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine communication and revelation.
data.etymology: Naba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awakening, Announcement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naba total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نبا
in_arabic.meaning: نبا تعني الخبر أو النبأ العظيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: نبا هو اسم مشتق من النبأ وهو الخبر أو الحدث العظيم. ورد ذكر النبأ في القرآن الكريم في سورة النبأ، وهي سورة مكية، وتحدثت عن يوم القيامة ووصف الجنة والنار. يعتبر اسم نبا ذا دلالة دينية وروحية كبيرة، حيث يرتبط بالمعرفة والفهم العميق للأحداث والأنباء.

in_urdu.name: نبا
in_urdu.meaning: نبا کا مطلب ہے خبر یا اہم واقعہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نبا ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے لفظ 'نبأ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خبر یا اہم واقعہ۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، نبا ایک ایسا نام ہے جو علم اور سمجھ باری تعلق رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے، جہاں یہ علم، حکمت اور اہم معلومات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नबा
in_hindi.meaning: नबा का अर्थ है समाचार या महत्वपूर्ण घटना
in_hindi.long_meaning: नबा एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'नबअ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है समाचार या महत्वपूर्ण घटना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, नबा एक ऐसा नाम है जो ज्ञान और समझ से संबंधित है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है, जहां यह ज्ञान, बुद्धिमत्ता और महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी को दर्शाता है।

In modern usage, Naba is used across Muslim cultures to signify a person who is knowledgeable and wise.

According to Islamic belief, Gabriel was the Angel appointed by Allah to convey His messages to Prophets and Messengers including Adam, Moses, Jesus, and Muhammad (pbuh). This shows that the name Naba is a symbol of important communication between the divine and human realms and reflects the Islamic tradition of communication through revelation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Naba signifies the importance of divine communication in the human journey towards attaining closeness to Allah. In Islamic teachings, every creature and event in the universe is a manifestation of Allah's will and His communication with His Creation. Therefore, the name Naba evokes a sense of awe and reverence towards Allah, reminding Muslims to remain attuned to His signs and messages in their daily lives.
